meta.name: migrate-from-openclaw
meta.description: Migrate from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2. Detects an existing OpenClaw installation, extracts identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then guides interactive migration. Triggers on "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", "import from openclaw".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 OpenClaw 配置迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在从 OpenClaw 迁移到 NanoClaw v2
copy.tagline_en: Migrate your OpenClaw configuration to NanoClaw v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are migrating from OpenClaw to NanoClaw v2

howto.what: 检测已安装的 OpenClaw,读出其中身份、频道、定时任务等配置,带你逐项确认后把数据迁入 NanoClaw v2;每次改动前先展示方案,不静默复制。
howto.when: 当你说出“migrate from openclaw”、“openclaw migration”、“import from openclaw”时触发。

say.text: 把 OpenClaw 的配置迁到 NanoClaw v2
say.note: 会先检测旧安装并列出迁移步骤

say.text: 从 OpenClaw 导入频道、身份和定时任务

say.note: 会运行发现脚本并询问你如何迁移

howto.what_en: Detects an existing OpenClaw install, reads identity, channel credentials, scheduled tasks, and other config, then walks you through confirming each item before moving data into NanoClaw v2. Shows proposed changes; never copies silently.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "migrate from openclaw", "openclaw migration", or "import from openclaw".

say_en.text: Migrate OpenClaw's config to NanoClaw v2.
say_en.note: Detects the old install and lists the migration steps.

say_en.text: Import channels, identity, and scheduled tasks from OpenClaw.

say_en.note: Runs discovery and asks how to proceed.
